title.en: The little horse crosses the river

excerpt.en: The ox and the squirrel both told the truth. They just stood a little differently in the water.
excerpt.zh: 老牛和松鼠讲的都是实话。他们的个头差得远。

zh: 上回写近况，还在说投了不少简历，一个面试也没等来。这回运气好，去了纽约，参加了 Barclays 的 Superday。以前一想到找工作，心里就发虚。如今再想起这三个字，倒能想起坐在对面的人了。
小时候读《小马过河》，总觉得小马多此一问，下去走走就是了。轮到自己，站在岸上，也恨不得把过路的都问一遍。老牛和松鼠讲的都是实话。他们的个头差得远。水到我身上什么地方，这回我也知道一点了。
面试有个好处，碰到难题，还容我想一想。守门员扑点球可没这个工夫。我还是面试吧。
en: The last time I wrote here, I’d sent out a pile of applications and was still waiting for a single interview. This time I got lucky. I went to New York for Barclays’ Superday. The words “job hunting” used to make me uneasy. Now when I hear them, I can picture the person sitting across from me.

As a child I wondered why the little horse in the story had so many questions about crossing the river. Just wade in and see. When my turn came, I’d gladly have asked everybody who passed along the bank. The ox and the squirrel both told the truth. There’s quite a difference in their heights. Now I have some idea where the water comes up to on me.
One nice thing about an interview is that a hard question leaves me a moment to think. A goalkeeper facing a penalty doesn’t get that moment. I’ll take the interview.

excerpt.en: A happy day, a few good friends to spend time with—that’s not bad.
excerpt.zh: 一天过得开心，有几个好朋友，可以一起玩，就还不错。

en: Lately I’ve sent out quite a few applications and taken quite a few online assessments. Afterwards, I wait to hear back. I keep waiting, but not a single interview has come.
Then I thought of Brush Up Life and Hot Spot. Maybe we don’t have to keep thinking about moving up. A happy day, a few good friends to spend time with—that’s not bad.
zh: 近来投了不少简历，也做了不少线上测评。做完了等消息，等来等去，一个面试也没有。
又想起《重启人生》和《热点》。我想，人也不必总惦记着往上走。一天过得开心，有几个好朋友，可以一起玩，就还不错。

excerpt.en: I attended Zorich’s Workshop on Applied Statistics & AI and had a rewarding conversation with Dr. Quan Zhou.
excerpt.zh: 参加了 Zorich’s Workshop on Applied Statistics & AI，也和 Dr. Quan Zhou 聊了聊，很有收获。

en: I attended the 2026 Zorich’s Workshop on Applied Statistics & AI. I also had a chance to chat with Dr. Quan Zhou and learned a lot from our conversation.
zh: 参加了 2026 Zorich’s Workshop on Applied Statistics & AI，也和 Dr. Quan Zhou 聊了聊，这次交流让我很有收获。

excerpt.en: I learned a lot at the CRSE Workshop. Everyone was very kind. Driving in Philadelphia was difficult for me.
excerpt.zh: 费城的 CRSE Workshop 学到了很多，大家都很亲切。在费城开车对我来说有点难。

en: I went to the CRSE Workshop in Philadelphia and learned a lot. Everyone was very kind. Driving in Philadelphia was pretty difficult for me.
zh: 去了费城的 CRSE Workshop，学到了很多，大家都很亲切。对我来说，在费城开车确实有点难。

excerpt.en: I felt the presentation went pretty well, though I didn’t win a prize.
excerpt.zh: 讲得还不错，不过没有拿到奖。

en: I took part in the INFORMS poster competition. I felt the presentation went pretty well, though I didn’t win a prize.
zh: 参加了 INFORMS 的海报比赛，讲得还不错，不过没有拿到奖。
